svg.text: Cut 57 long; ends square to 0.5; deburr inside and out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore 17.3 passes the M16 bolt; 21.3 outside slides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into the 21.5 hole in the back wall of the post.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: one end bears on the inside of the canal-side wall;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the other is flush with the back face, under the 50 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: washer. It stops the bolt crushing the post walls.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: push it in; it must stop on the far wall with its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end flush (within 0.5) with the back face.
